content.short: Home solar and battery provider whose DayFi protocol turns electricity revenue into on-chain yield.
content.description: Daylight installs solar panels and batteries in homes for no upfront cost, charging a monthly rate below the local utility, and currently operates in Illinois and Massachusetts. Its DayFi protocol finances those installations on-chain: GRID is a stablecoin backed by Treasuries and cash, and sGRID adds a share of the revenue the solar systems earn. DayFi's first deployment outside Ethereum is on Plasma, and Daylight is backed by a16z and Framework.
content.meta: Daylight's DayFi protocol funds home solar and pays sGRID holders a share of the electricity revenue, on Plasma.
